plugin.plugin_botlife.name: BotLife
plugin.plugin_botlife.description: A life simulator like BitLife: be born, grow up, study, work, fall in love, buy houses, break the law and die, year by year in a private panel. Continue as your child.
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.start.label: BotLife panel
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.start.descrip: Opens the member's life panel (a new life when there is none).
Gender for a new life (male, female, empty: random)
First name for a new life
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.profile.label: BotLife profile
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.profile.descr: A member's life as a public card.
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.profile.confi: Member (empty: the one who ran it)
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.top.label: BotLife ranking
plugin.plugin_botlife.node.top.descripti: The richest, oldest or longest families of the server.
plugin.plugin_botlife.setting.language_h: For new lives; a life keeps the language it was born with.
plugin.plugin_botlife.setting.crime_hint: Shoplifting, burglary, bank robbery … with prison.
plugin.plugin_botlife.setting.cooldown_h: Stops fast clicking through a whole life (0: no wait).
plugin.plugin_botlife.setting.obituary_c: When a life ends, a short obituary is posted here. Empty: none.
